subject: Request: Dedicated reserve augmentation and burst pricing — Crescent Bio POC
messages:
From: Emily Hart <emily@crescentbio.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T08:12:00Z
Subject: Request: Dedicated reserve augmentation and burst pricing — Crescent Bio POC

Hi Jordan / Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Crescent is excited to start the POC next month. One ask from our engineering team: we expect a short, high-intensity traffic spike during test runs that exceeds our reserved baseline. To keep latency predictable we need: 

- Temporary burst access to an additional 120 L40 GPU v-slots (mixed-precision optimized pods) for an anticipated 6-week window starting 2026-11-10.
- A reservation hold (to prevent reallocation) for the first 45 days of the POC start date.
- A capped overage premium — ideally limited to a 35% premium over standard on-demand rates during the burst window.

Attached is a traffic forecast (Crescent_MVP_traffic_forecast.csv) and a short mutual action plan. We can sign an amendment if legal/finance need it; Ravi (cc) will be our procurement lead.

Can you advise next steps and whether Redwood can commit to a temporary hold + overage cap for a partner POC?

Thanks,
Emily Hart
Head of Engineering, Crescent Bio
(emily@crescentbio.com)

Attachments: Crescent_MVP_traffic_forecast.csv
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-28T11:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: Dedicated reserve augmentation and burst pricing — Crescent Bio POC

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Crescent's ask. TL;DR: 6-week POC burst (120 L40 v-slots), 45-day reservation hold, overage premium cap at 35%. Client is SMB-to-midmarket and likely to convert to a Dedicated commit if POC performance is solid.

Recommendation (from AE):
- Approve a temporary reservation hold for up to 45 days from the POC start (start target 2026-11-10).
- Allow burst capacity at up to 3x their baseline (explicitly 120 additional L40 v-slots) for a 6-week period.
- Cap overage charges to a 35% premium over standard on-demand for the burst window.
- Require a signed amendment (DocuSign) that includes the start/end dates, traffic caps, and that any extended burst converts to a billed overage at standard premium rates.

I think this is a low-risk concession: L40s are available in the requested region and this is time-limited. We should gate the approval on legal amending T&Cs and finance pre-approving the overage cap. Please advise if you need alternate pricing bands or a shorter hold window.

Jordan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

1) Baseline reserve details — what is Crescent's committed baseline today (v-slots / hours)? We need that to calculate the 3x baseline figure you quoted.
2) Start date & slack — confirm the exact POC start date and whether the hold must start on day 0 or can be backdated within a 7-day window.
3) Risk cap — finance: the 35% premium cap is unusual for short-term bursts; we need an expected $ exposure delta for the 6-week window. If you can provide the traffic forecast and an expected peak QPS, that helps us run worst-case.

Cc'ing Laura Bennett (Revenue Ops) to help model the exposure. Once we have those numbers I'll escalate to Lauren for exec approval and route a conditional DocuSign amendment for signature.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-29T09:42:00Z
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: Dedicated reserve augmentation and burst pricing — Crescent Bio POC

Thanks team — I reviewed the request and the forecast Marissa requested. Summary decision and constraints:

- Executive approval: GRANTED (conditional).
- Approval specifics: We will allow a temporary reservation hold for 45 days from the POC start date, plus burst capacity up to 120 L40 v-slots for a 6-week window.
- Financial constraints: Cap the overage premium at 30% (reduced from the requested 35%) for the burst window. Any usage beyond the agreed traffic caps will revert to standard on-demand surcharges.
- Operational constraints: The hold must be explicitly start-dated in the amendment; engineering will provision the L40 pods only after DocuSign is executed.
- Expiration: This approval is valid for 7 calendar days from this email (i.e., until 2026-11-05). If the DocuSign isn't signed and countersigned by then, the request must be re-reviewed.

Requirements before I sign off on the amendment: finance must confirm expected exposure numbers (Laura), and legal must add an amendment clause that limits Redwood's liability for POC-produced data. Once those are in place I'll countersign the executive block.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
